decision_conditions:
This proposal CONSTITUTES DEVELOPMENT within the meaning of Section 55 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990, and a planning application IS REQUIRED. This is because the proposal fails to comply with criteria within Class A, and C of Part 1 Schedule 2 laid down in the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) (England) Order 2015 (as amended) and any subsequent legislative amendments. Specifically, the scheme fails to comply with criteria A.1 (f), A.1 (g), A.1 (i), A.1 (j), A.1 (ja) and A.3 (a). This is because:
- The proposed dwellinghouse is not detached and the proposed ground floor extension is proposed to be 3.7m from the original rear elevation A.1 (f). 
- The application is not a prior approval application A.1 (g).
- The side bay window would fall within 2m of the shared boundary and will have an eaves height of greater than 3m A.1 (i). 
- The proposed ground floor extension, when considering the side and rear elements together, would extend beyond a side wall and have a width greater than half the width of the original dwellinghouse A.1 (j).
- The proposed first floor side elevation bay window would extend beyond a side elevation of the original dwellinghouse and would exceed 4m in height and have more than a single storey A.1 (j).
- The proposed ground floor extension, when considering the side and rear elements together, would extend beyond a side wall and have a width greater than half the width of the original dwellinghouse A.1 (ja).
- The proposed fenestration and zinc cladding would be of a different visual appearance to the existing windows and materials used on the rest of the house/roof A.3 (a).
description: Single storey ground floor rear/extension. First Floor side bay window. First floor rear bay window. Roof light to main roof.
